## Statement · **draft**
Let $G$ be a group. An isomorphism from $G$ to itself, $\sigma : G \to G$, is called an **automorphism**; all automorphisms form a group under composition,

$\operatorname{Aut}(G) \le \operatorname{Sym}(G),$

the **automorphism group** of $G$.
